meta.audience: people who start small habits alone and keep them going with a few friends
meta.title: LOOP
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/styles/app.css in the app repository), its chrome ring and wordmark code (Rings.tsx, App.tsx), its sample routines and example crew, and its captured screens. Periwinkle #B9CCF0 / #E6ECF7 ground, navy #1F3566 / ink #16264A, the chrome torus (its conic gradient from 205deg) as the one bright object.

source.notes: a habit app where the day is a ring: check small routines, keep streaks, and share progress with a crew through invite links and check-in cards, no server
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json: today's check-in list at three moments, the crew board, a cheer, the sixteen-week heatmap
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's tokens: periwinkle #B9CCF0 / #D3DFF6 / #E7EDF9 and its page #E6ECF7, paper #F7F9FD, navy #1F3566 / #2A4580, ink #16264A / #3D4F78 / #56668C; the chrome torus (conic, from 205deg, white to #2B3656) with its navy inlay #2B4A8C to #14254A.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable at 900 for the wordmark (L, the two linked chrome rings, P) and 800 for headlines in ink; mono capitals for the app's labels (TODAY / W42, TOGETHER / CREW BOARD).
rationale.motion: A day closing like a ring: taps on the beat, a counter climbing, the navy inlay sweeping round the chrome torus, and when the last loop closes the app's own celebration, a single glint round the ring and a small pop.
rationale.sound: Corporate in C major at 128 BPM (8 bars in 15 s, 16 in 30 s): bright, steady and encouraging, with a soft tap for each check-in.
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: the name and the app's line beside its chrome ring; today's routines checked off as the ring fills to 3/3 and glints; the example crew's board and a cheer; the end card. The 30 s cut adds the sixteen-week heatmap.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
